rules.when: investigation, analysis, code reading, reviewing someone else's proposal, answering a question about how something works
rules.why: mostly reading and reasoning; no large diff is expected

rules.when: architecture and structural decisions: choosing a boundary, a data model, a migration shape, or judging whether a design holds
rules.why: architecture role work, deliberately separated from implementation ownership

rules.when: adversarial challenge of a plan or a claim, tenth-man review, risk analysis before a costly commitment
rules.why: tenth-man role; independent scrutiny, not delivery

rules.when: a small surgical edit in a known place, a one-file fix, a rename, a config change
rules.why: bounded and quick; a full coding harness buys nothing here

rules.when: implementing a feature, debugging a defect, refactoring, or writing and repairing tests
rules.why: primary coding harness for work that writes a lot of code and runs it
